metadata.selection: 150 original source records plus one documented RIP command to populate its target view
metadata.parameter_types: Derived from ParaDef and selected name heuristics; string also represents enum, MAC, prefix and dotted AS values
metadata.switch_to_view_extraction: FuncDef destinations preserved; missing entries and group membership recovered from documented example prompts and ParentView

switch_to_view_source.text: The acl number command creates an ACL and displays the ACL view.
The acl number command creates an ACL and displays the ACL view.
The bgp command enables BGP and displays the BGP view or displays the BGP view directly.

system view.format: configuration file auto-save backup-to-server server <server-ip> [ vpn-instance <vpn-instance-name> ] transport-type { tftp | { ftp | sftp } [ port <port-value> ] user <user-name> password <password> } [ path <folder> ]

switch_to_view_source.text: The grpc command displays the gRPC view.

system view.format: ip import-rib vpn-instance <vpn-instance-name> protocol static [ valid-route ] [ route-policy <route-policy-name> ]

switch_to_view_source.text:
<HUAWEI> system-view
[~HUAWEI] isis 1
[*HUAWEI-isis-1] ipv6 enable
[*HUAWEI-isis-1] ipv6 circuit-cost 20

system view.format: multicast layer-2 invalid-packet igmp snooping max-count <max-Num>

switch_to_view_source.text:
<HUAWEI> system-view
[~HUAWEI] ip vpn-instance vpn1
[*HUAWEI-vpn-instance-vpn1] ipv4-family
[*HUAWEI-vpn-instance-vpn1-af-ipv4] quit
[*HUAWEI-vpn-instance-vpn1] quit
[*HUAWEI] ospf 1 vpn-instance vpn1
[*HUAWEI-ospf-1] domain-id 234

<HUAWEI> system-view
[~HUAWEI] bfd
[*HUAWEI-bfd] quit
[*HUAWEI] rip
[*HUAWEI-rip-1] bfd all-interfaces enable
The route-policy command creates a route-policy and displays the Route-policy view.

system view.format: undo multicast layer-2 invalid-packet mld snooping

switch_to_view_source.text: The vlan command creates a VLAN and displays the VLAN view.

<HUAWEI> system-view
[~HUAWEI] bgp 100
[*HUAWEI-bgp] ipv4-family unicast
[*HUAWEI-bgp-af-ipv4] default local-preference 200
The ipv6-family command configures a BGP IPv6 address family and displays the BGP IPv6 address family view.

bgp view.format: undo peer <groupName> advertise add-path path-number <number> route-policy <route-policy-name>

bgp-ipv4 unicast address family view.format: filter-policy { <acl-number> | ip-prefix <ip-prefix-name> | acl-name <acl-name> } { import | export [ direct | { isis | ospf | rip } <process-id> | static ] }

switch_to_view_source.text: The grpc server command displays the gRPC IPv4 server view.
The grpc server ipv6 command displays the gRPC IPv6 server view.

acl view.format: rule [ <rule-id> ] [ name <rule-name> ] { permit | deny } [ fragment-type fragment | source { <source-ip-address> { <source-wildcard> | 0 | <src-netmask> } | any } | time-range <time-name> | [ vpn-instance <vpn-instance-name> | vpn-instance-any ] | logging ] *

undo rule [ name <rule-name> ] { permit | deny } [ fragment-type fragment | source { <source-ip-address> { <source-wildcard> | 0 | <src-netmask> } | any } | time-range <time-name> | [ vpn-instance <vpn-instance-name> | vpn-instance-any ] | logging ] *

vlan view.format: undo ip source check user-bind alarm enable

ospf view.format: filter-lsa-out peer <peer-addr> { all | { ase [ acl { <ase-acl-num> | <ase-acl-name> } ] | nssa [ acl { <nssa-acl-num> | <nssa-acl-name> } ] | summary [ acl { <sum-acl-num> | <sum-acl-name> } ] } * }
undo filter-policy [ <acl-number> | acl-name <acl-name> | ip-prefix <ip-prefix-name> | route-policy <route-policy-name> ] export bgp
undo import-route limit [ <limit-number> ] [ threshold-alarm [ upper-limit <upper-limit-value> | lower-limit <lower-limit-value> ] * ]

is-is view.format: cost-style { narrow | wide | wide-compatible | { compatible | narrow-compatible } [ relax-spf-limit ] }
import-route { ospf | isis } [ <process-id> ] inherit-cost [ { level-1 | level-2 | level-1-2 } | tag <tag> | route-policy <route-policy-name> ] *

ipv6 filter-policy { <acl6-number> | acl6-name <acl6-name-string> | ipv6-prefix <ipv6-prefix-name> | route-policy <route-policy-name> } { export [ direct | static | ripng <process-id> | bgp | ospfv3 <process-id> | isis <process-id> ] }

ipv6 import-route isis level-2 into level-1 [ tag <tag> | filter-policy { <acl6-number> | acl6-name <acl6-name-string> | ipv6-prefix <ipv6-prefix-name> | route-policy <route-policy-name> } | direct { allow-filter-policy | allow-up-down-bit } * ] *
undo ipv6 import-route { direct | static | { ospfv3 | ripng | isis } [ <process-id> ] | bgp }
